canonical_name: Cook County Criminal Court House and Jail complex

notes: Worship was held in the basement from spring 1873; the new cruciform building was completed February 15, 1874, resembled its predecessor externally, seated 1,800, and cost $105,000 including its organ.

Andreas states completion in fall 1874, dedication by Bishop Foley, and about $30,000 cost. Exact address remains unresolved because Chicago later had multiple parishes of this name.
